object: ZIF-8 composite membranes for membrane distillation
problem: How to raise flux and anti-fouling of membrane distillation membranes while capturing volatile organic compounds
mechanism_or_method: 92% ZIF-8 loaded omniphobic membrane; VOC trapping via crystal phase transition and water evaporation enhanced by linkage swing in micropores
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term performance with real industrial wastewater not shown beyond 900 h cycling

problem: How can oxygen chemical potential be used to predict and achieve single-phase synthesis of Mn- and Fe-containing high-entropy oxides
mechanism_or_method: Valence phase diagram from thermodynamics plus ML interatomic potential enthalpy maps; synthesis under controlled oxygen chemical potential with XRD and XAFS
limitation: Demonstrated only for rock salt compositions; property performance of the oxides not evaluated

problem: How to make RO membranes that reject toxic micropollutants such as boron and arsenite while keeping high water permeance
mechanism_or_method: Thermal-intensified interfacial polymerization: heating speeds amine diffusion, giving highly crosslinked polyamide with nanovoids
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; scale-up and long-term fouling stability not shown in abstract

object: high-entropy metal oxide carbon nanocoil composites for GHz absorption
problem: How do entropy, helical strain and spin-orbit coupling jointly govern GHz electromagnetic dissipation in chiral composites
mechanism_or_method: HEMO@carbon nanocoil composites characterized by microscopy and EM measurements, with DFT linking defects and spin-orbit coupling to loss
limitation: Mechanistic attribution rests on DFT of idealized models; practical absorber thickness and cost not addressed

problem: Why do highly extended double-network gels deswell on extension and soften on drying, opposite to normal gels
mechanism_or_method: Mechanical and swelling experiments plus hyperelastic and swelling models showing extreme nonlinear elasticity of the first network drives the inverse coupling
limitation: Shown for specific DN gel chemistries; generality to other networks untested
decision_relevance: Constitutive models for gels near fracture must include inverse swelling coupling

object: flexible porous coordination polymer for CO2 capture
problem: How can a soft porous framework selectively gate-open for CO2 over nine similar gases
mechanism_or_method: Corrugated channel PCP combining stereochemical shape, binding site location and structural softness for exclusive discrimination gating; in-situ crystallography and theory
limitation: Performance shown on lab breakthrough tests; humidity and long-term cycling stability not stated

problem: How can low-temperature plasticity of brittle boron carbide be enabled while keeping strength
mechanism_or_method: High-pressure sintering creates boundary non-stoichiometry that promotes grain boundary diffusion and sliding, lowering plastic deformation temperature by 200 C
limitation: Plasticity still requires elevated temperature; small high-pressure sintered specimens limit scale
decision_relevance: Suggests grain boundary chemistry control for processing and forming of hard ceramics

object: crack tip in body-centered cubic molybdenum
problem: What atomistic mechanisms govern nanoscale ductile fracture and the ductile-to-brittle transition in BCC refractory metals
mechanism_or_method: In situ atomic-resolution TEM of crack growth in Mo single crystals plus atomistic simulations of temperature and strain-rate effects
limitation: Nanoscale single-crystal samples; link to macroscopic polycrystal fracture toughness not established

object: micro-vacuum transfer printing of inorganic microchips
problem: How to selectively transfer micro-sized semiconductors without adhesives, stamp wear or chip damage
mechanism_or_method: Laser-drilled glass micro-hole array with hard-PDMS vacuum channels giving switchable suction adhesion of 3.4 million times
limitation: Demonstrated at micro-LED scale and 25 PPI; throughput for large-area manufacturing unproven

problem: How to grow isolated atomically thin MOF single crystals and integrate them with MoS2
mechanism_or_method: Self-condensation-assisted chemical vapour deposition yielding poly[Fe(benzimidazole)2] monolayers up to 62 micrometers, grown onto MoS2
limitation: Single MOF chemistry and small crystals; sensing shown only for ammonia

object: diffusion and chemical ordering in NbMoTa refractory alloy
problem: How to model path-dependent atomic diffusion and chemical ordering in compositionally complex alloys at scale
mechanism_or_method: Neural network kinetics predicting all migration barriers on a lattice to drive kinetic simulation of atom jumps
limitation: Lattice-based and trained on atomistic barriers; no experimental validation of predicted ordering temperature stated

object: C2C12 myotubes on liquid crystalline polymer networks
problem: Does substrate stiffness anisotropy alone coordinate collective contractility and long-range myotube alignment
mechanism_or_method: Mechanically anisotropic liquid crystal polymer networks without topography versus isotropic controls, tracking myoblast polarization and fusion
limitation: In vitro cell line on engineered substrates; in vivo relevance not shown

problem: How to double the coefficient of performance of elastocaloric cooling systems
mechanism_or_method: TiNiCu nanocrystalline refrigerant with better lattice compatibility combined with roller mechanism recovering kinetic energy at 78% work recovery
limitation: Prototype scale; fatigue life of TiNiCu and full system efficiency versus vapor compression not shown
decision_relevance: Favors kinetic energy recovery and TiNiCu in elastocaloric refrigerator design

problem: How to achieve much faster stress relaxation in acrylate vitrimers for reprocessing
mechanism_or_method: Carboxy exchange via conjugate substitution on alpha-(acyloxymethyl) acrylate crosslinks catalyzed by DABCO, giving 2 s relaxation at 140 C
limitation: Needs DABCO catalyst and elevated temperature; long-term creep and aging not reported

problem: Can scrap aluminum be solid-phase alloyed into high-strength 7075-like alloy without melting
mechanism_or_method: Solid-phase recycling with simultaneous alloying of Cu, Zn, Mg forming dense Guinier-Preston zones and eta-prime nanoprecipitates
limitation: Lab-scale processing; fatigue, corrosion and impurity tolerance of scrap feedstock not covered in abstract
decision_relevance: Supports solid-state upcycling of aluminum scrap instead of remelting

object: Ni-Pd/CeO2 catalyst for epoxy resin hydrogenolysis
problem: How to depolymerize epoxy resins and recover fibers with a reusable solid catalyst under 1 atm H2
mechanism_or_method: CeO2-supported Ni-Pd bimetallic catalyst with synergy for selective C-O bond hydrogenolysis
limitation: Lab-scale reactions; tested on limited epoxy composite types and catalyst reuse only several cycles

object: bioinspired thermochromic metafilm for radiative cooling and raindrop electricity
problem: How to enable all-weather thermal regulation and energy harvesting beyond clear-sky radiative cooling
mechanism_or_method: Sandwich metafilm with FEP/ITO outer layers for droplet triboelectric generation and thermochromic core for self-regulated heating and cooling
limitation: Small-area films; durability under long outdoor exposure and cost not detailed

problem: How to enable long-term wearable transcranial ultrasound neuromodulation without dehydrating coupling gel
mechanism_or_method: Air-cavity Fresnel lens self-focusing transducer with bioadhesive hydrogel couplant, stable over 35 days
limitation: Efficacy shown on somatosensory evoked potentials in limited subjects; clinical outcomes and safety unproven

problem: How to cut high-frequency core loss in Fe-rich soft magnetic ribbons
mechanism_or_method: Partial alpha-Fe nanocrystallization induces perpendicular anisotropy and narrow stripe domains, cutting core loss 55% to about 75 W/kg
limitation: Ribbon-scale lab samples; stability under thermal aging and in assembled cores not shown

object: flexible electronic soft robots with embodied AI
problem: How to give small soft robots integrated multimodal sensing, actuation and autonomous decision-making
mechanism_or_method: Modular flexible electronic components and setae modules with onboard computing for locomotion, proprioception, exteroception and adaptive behaviors
limitation: Demonstrated in controlled lab environments; power autonomy and robustness outdoors not stated

object: thin-film composite reverse osmosis membranes with LDH nanofillers
problem: How to overcome the permeability-selectivity trade-off of RO membranes
mechanism_or_method: LDH and sodium lignosulfonate create spatial fluctuation in MPD diffusion during interfacial polymerization, giving wrinkled thin polyamide with hydrogen-bond water network
limitation: Lab-scale coupons; long-term fouling and chlorine stability not reported

problem: What mechanisms and kinetics govern noncatalytic soot oxidation as a function of nanostructure maturity
mechanism_or_method: In situ TEM oxidation of methane-derived soot, with a maturity parameter, simplified aggregate kinetic model and core-shell separation model
limitation: Small-sample in situ TEM under vacuum-like conditions may differ from real combustion environments

problem: Why does a refractory high-entropy alloy soften during aging at 700 C
mechanism_or_method: Aging experiments with analytical microscopy, CALPHAD and nanoindentation showing interstitial O and N drive phase segregation, depleting matrix solid solution strengthening
limitation: One alloy and one aging temperature; macroscopic creep or tensile consequences not measured
decision_relevance: Interstitial impurity control is needed for service of refractory high-entropy alloys

problem: Can collisions of soliton-like pulses nucleate phase transitions in multistable metamaterials
mechanism_or_method: Experiments on 2D multistable lattice plus validated numerical model showing critical nucleus formed by pulse collisions then transition-wave propagation
limitation: Collision-induced nucleation shown numerically only; experiments cover limited lattice sizes

problem: How to fill auxetic perforations while keeping a negative Poisson's ratio of -1
mechanism_or_method: Rigid glass-fabric-reinforced auxetic structure with surface-flattening soft elastomer, with moduli ratios optimized
limitation: Demonstrated at 25 PPI display scale; fatigue under repeated stretching not reported

problem: How to navigate a swarm of cyborg insects with variable responses to control input through unknown obstructed terrain
mechanism_or_method: Swarm navigation algorithm accounting for individual variability, verified experimentally in sandy terrain with obstacles and hills
limitation: Small swarms of living insects in lab terrain; scalability and insect welfare constraints unaddressed

object: crown-ether functionalized covalent organic framework membranes
problem: How to build artificial channels with biological-like Na+/K+ selectivity and high permeance
mechanism_or_method: 15-crown-5 functionalized COF membrane whose 1D channels recognize Na+ and lower its energy barrier versus K+
limitation: Single-ion pair tests in lab; performance in mixed real brines and scale-up not shown

problem: What is the early-stage oxidation pathway of boron and the intermediate that limits its combustion
mechanism_or_method: Identification of interfacial B6O intermediate forming at the B/B2O3 boundary, termed the W-J model, replacing diffusion through oxide
limitation: Model derived from model particles; effect on actual propellant combustion efficiency inferred not tested
decision_relevance: Guides boron fuel treatment to avoid stable B6O barrier formation

problem: How to make moldable shape-memory materials programmable into arbitrary bulk 3D shapes
mechanism_or_method: Main-chain LCE microparticles dispersed in silicone matrix; low-temperature glassiness freezes mechanical deformation, thermally reset; magnetic alignment adds actuation
limitation: Programming requires cooling cycles; shape fixity and cycle life quantification not detailed

problem: Can simple pen drawing of Marangoni fuel ink produce programmable swimming robots
mechanism_or_method: Ink-based Marangoni fuel drawn on substrates; drawn geometry encodes trajectories, maze navigation and multi-step tasks with time-varying substrates
limitation: Operates on water surfaces with limited lifetime from fuel depletion

object: oriented HKUST-1 membranes for alkane isomer separation
problem: How to extract linear alkanes from isomer mixtures with far less energy than distillation
mechanism_or_method: Morphology-biased low-dose synthesis of oriented HKUST-1 with triangular sieving pores inducing configurational entropic diffusion
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; energy saving versus distillation estimated, not demonstrated at industrial scale

problem: What governs the kinetics of CO2-induced structural transition in flexible MOFs
mechanism_or_method: Time-resolved in situ XRD and a generalized kinetic model with gate-opening pressure and autocatalytic reaction terms with two CO2 penetration pathways
limitation: Detailed model validated mainly on one MOF; two others only by adsorption analysis

object: nitride superlattice ceramics with anion vacancies
problem: How to raise elasticity and strength of ceramics simultaneously despite high vacancy concentrations
mechanism_or_method: Nitride superlattice with up to 50% disordered anion vacancies deforming by unit-cell disturbance that relieves local stress without dislocations
limitation: Thin-film or small specimens; toughness and behavior at high temperature not stated

problem: How to color brittle inert carbon fibers with durable tunable color
mechanism_or_method: In-situ growth of carbon spheres on fiber surfaces from glucose, giving structural color tuned by sphere size, inspired by peacock feathers
limitation: Lab-scale fiber coloring; effect on composite structural performance and scalability only qualitatively addressed

object: anion-functionalized MOFs for hexane isomer separation
problem: How to sort hexane isomers with high selectivity while lowering regeneration energy
mechanism_or_method: Rotational freedom of linkers and SnF6 anions in adaptive frameworks regulates host-guest energy, enabling mild vacuum regeneration
limitation: Breakthrough tests at lab scale; 45% energy saving is estimated versus zeolite 5A

problem: How to accurately predict strength and permeability from limited test data and optimize mix design
mechanism_or_method: Kriging-based surrogate with MCMC data enrichment feeding an ANN, then optimization of cement content and compaction force
limitation: Trained on limited laboratory specimens of one material; transfer to field pavements untested
decision_relevance: Selects cement content and compaction force for permeable pavement bases

problem: Can wastewater sensor data predict firm-level hazardous waste generation across sectors
mechanism_or_method: Data-driven framework using data balancing for long-tail distributions and causal discovery for feature screening on daily wastewater data
limitation: Single province in China; correlation-based proxy may not generalize to other regulatory settings

problem: What mechanism causes freezing to fracture soft wet materials
mechanism_or_method: Observed ice-filled crack growth in model hydrogels, showing cryosuction dehydrates adjacent gel causing drying-induced fracture rather than expansion pressure
limitation: Model brittle hydrogels only; extension to real tissues, food or soils not demonstrated
decision_relevance: Reframes frost heave and cryopreservation damage as desiccation cracking rather than expansion

object: amorphous powder cores for power electronics
problem: How to lower core loss and raise DC bias in amorphous powder cores beyond cold compaction
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasonic rheomolding forms local adaptive biconcave-lens insulation buffering stress and reducing porosity
limitation: Small lab cores; manufacturing throughput of ultrasonic rheomolding not addressed

object: fluorophenyl oligomer-incorporated HKUST-1 for atmospheric water harvesting
problem: How to harvest water quickly at low humidity with sunlight-driven desorption using water-sensitive MOFs
mechanism_or_method: Vapor-phase polymerization of fluorophenyl in HKUST-1 forms oligomers that boost hydrolytic stability and sorption kinetics
limitation: Outdoor test was a single device run; long-term cycling and weather variability not shown

problem: How to monitor cardiovascular signs continuously with skin-conformal wearable ultrasound across curvatures and depths
mechanism_or_method: Skin-adaptive focused ultrasound array design with self-adhesive hydrogel couplant and MEMS-compatible batch fabrication
limitation: Clinical validation cohort size and long-term wear performance not stated

problem: How to achieve large range and high precision endoluminal manipulation without actuation cross-talk
mechanism_or_method: Optical fibers as tendons and waveguides actuating macro continuum robot and light-driven LCE micro parallel robot with decoupled motion
limitation: Animal studies only; clinical sterilization, force capacity and regulatory path not addressed

problem: What is the hydrated 3D structure of polyamide RO layers and how does it relate to water transport
mechanism_or_method: Cryo-electron tomography of six commercial membranes revealing nodular networks, with structural parameters correlated to permeance of 16 additional membranes
limitation: Correlation across membranes rather than controlled causal test; cryo-ET sample preparation may alter structure

problem: Can tire-road interaction energy be harvested effectively to power smart transportation systems
mechanism_or_method: Embedded freestanding-layer triboelectric nanogenerator array converting vibratory tire impact energy, plus a self-powered connected transportation system
limitation: Milliwatt output per tire impact; 1 km power supply is extrapolated and pavement durability unproven

problem: How to reach narrow tortuous vessels quickly and treat blood clots efficiently with low invasiveness
mechanism_or_method: Submillimeter catheter with magnetic soft rotatable tip enabling rotation-assisted steering, drug mixing, mechanical clot breakdown and debris retrieval
limitation: Validated in phantoms, rabbits and placenta model; human clinical safety unproven

problem: How to efficiently harvest disordered broadband wave energy for unmanned marine equipment
mechanism_or_method: Chaotic pendulum converting irregular waves to regular mechanical motion, driving triboelectric and electromagnetic generators with charge-excitation circuit
limitation: Short open-sea trials; long-term durability and corrosion resistance not reported

object: antifouling water treatment membranes with cyclodextrin-PDMS modifier
problem: How to improve membrane antifouling and permeability, especially at low tangential flow
mechanism_or_method: Threaded cyclodextrin-PDMS supramolecular assemblies form dynamic hydrophilic and low-energy microdomains giving resistance-release antifouling
limitation: Tested with model foulant BSA in lab; real wastewater fouling not shown

problem: How can interstitial oxygen be used to raise strength, ductility and fatigue resistance in large-scale titanium alloy
mechanism_or_method: Short-term powder metallurgy introduces 0.36 wt% O forming local-range-order oxygen structure that promotes c-type dislocations and delays crack initiation
limitation: Single alloy composition; fatigue tested at lab scale, scale of components and oxygen segregation over service life uncertain
decision_relevance: Permits oxygen as a low-cost strengthener in powder metallurgy titanium alloys

object: nanocolumnar copper film with amorphous boron framework
problem: Can a light-element amorphous grain boundary framework strengthen nanocrystalline copper
mechanism_or_method: Magnetron co-sputtered Cu-B film with copper nanocolumns confined in amorphous boron, reaching 10.8 GPa hardness
limitation: Thin sputtered films characterized by nanoindentation; bulk applicability and ductility not demonstrated

object: 3D orthogonal woven carbon composites under impact
problem: Can pulse current reduce impact damage in woven composites and by what mechanism
mechanism_or_method: Drop-weight tests with pulse current on integrated platform and a multi-field coupled damage model of temperature, current and damage
limitation: Laboratory coupons under low-velocity impact; practical power supply requirements for structures not addressed

problem: How do nanoscale solid, cage and frame lattice architectures differ in stiffness and strength
mechanism_or_method: DNA-assembled nanosolid, nanocage and nanoframe colloidal crystals tested by nanomechanics, microscopy and finite element analysis
limitation: Tiny crystals tested at nanoscale; scalability to macroscopic structures not shown

object: metallic glass joints made under liquids
problem: How to join metallic glasses under water, seawater, alcohol and liquid nitrogen without heat
mechanism_or_method: Ultrasonic vibration induces dynamic heterogeneity and liquid-like regions, dispersing oxide layers and enabling bonding
limitation: Small metallic glass specimens; joint size and reproducibility for structural parts not shown
decision_relevance: Enables heat-free underwater joining of metallic glass components

problem: How to fabricate robust micro/nanostructures carrying multichannel information in soft responsive hydrogels
mechanism_or_method: Dehydration stiffens hydrogel for femtosecond laser processing; high dose makes grooves, low dose alters fluorescence, encoding color, polarization and fluorescence
limitation: Serial laser writing limits throughput; application beyond optical information encoding unproven

object: laser powder bed fusion process mapping for new alloys
problem: How to quickly determine process windows and quantify defects for new 3D printed alloys in situ
mechanism_or_method: Video vision transformers on high-speed imaging of molten metal dynamics, with cross-dataset evaluation across alloys
limitation: Requires high-speed imaging on printers and alloy-specific data; limited alloy set evaluated
decision_relevance: Speeds selection of print parameters for new metal alloys

problem: How to get strong and ductile welds in ultra-high strength steel without nickel
mechanism_or_method: Combined Nb and Cr additions lower transformation temperature, refining interlocking microstructure with film-like retained austenite
limitation: Laboratory weld trials; performance in thick sections and varied welding conditions not reported
decision_relevance: Replaces Ni with Nb and Cr in weld filler, cutting cost by 45%

problem: How to create stable, high-density, reprogrammable mechanical memory beyond binary states
mechanism_or_method: Coupling kinematic bifurcation of rigid cube mechanisms with elasticity to make stretchable multistable platforms with independently actuated bistable voxels
limitation: Prototype-scale structures with manual or magnetic actuation; read-write speed and scalability not addressed

problem: How to simultaneously capture trace benzene and SO2 under humid conditions
mechanism_or_method: Robust pyrazolate MOF with accessible Ni(II) sites having low water affinity and high stability
limitation: Tested at 30% relative humidity in lab; real flue gas complexity and regeneration not shown

problem: How to make MOF membranes with high selectivity, mechanical endurance and scalability
mechanism_or_method: Scale-like tangential-normal interlaced ZIF-67 structure eliminating intergranular defects, restricting lattice flexibility and resisting abrasion
limitation: Scale-up shown only to 4 mm tubular substrates; industrial module performance unproven

object: copper alloy with Ni2MnSn Heusler nanoprecipitates
problem: How to design a copper alloy that is both ultra-strong and electromagnetically shielding
mechanism_or_method: Multi-objective design of Heusler precipitate parameters giving pinning strengthening and magnetic-electric coupling shielding of 110 dB
limitation: Lab-scale alloy; ductility, conductivity and thermal stability in service not detailed

problem: Can discrete particles with reconfigurable bonds give adaptive, reprogrammable mechanical metamaterials
mechanism_or_method: Bimaterial structured particles that assemble and unassemble through compression and thermal stimuli, altering compression, shear and bending behavior
limitation: Centimeter-scale prototypes with slow thermal stimuli; scalability and cycle durability not addressed
